description: This file implements the core functions for an HTTP request object within a server environment, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and cleanup routines. It defines a 'HttpBmoReq' object that manages HTTP request data such as client/server addresses, request methods, and CGI/RCP interfaces.

classes.name: HTTP_BMO_REQ_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing an HTTP request, managing request data, associated interfaces, and lifecycle functions.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpBmoReqCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new HttpBmoReq object, setting up function pointers and member variables.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoReqRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates the HttpBmoReq object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoReqEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls and allocates additional interface objects related to CGI and RCP based on compile-time flags.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoReqInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the HttpBmoReq object members, setting default values and function pointers.
